purpose: Privacy-conscious product backlog notes, not personal records or an execution manifest.

items.title: Reviewable one-sentence task planning
items.summary: Turn a plain-language request into a proposed task, role, priority, and next-step sequence; keep the result reviewable.

items.title: Local task memory and progress board
items.summary: Track backlog, in-progress, waiting, and done work locally with export and visible status.

items.title: Parallel worker planning
items.summary: Represent independent jobs as separate tasks and show their progress; require explicit configuration before connecting external workers.

items.title: Fold-friendly responsive interface
items.summary: Keep the taskbar, panels, and controls usable at narrow cover-screen and wide inner-screen sizes.

items.title: Local-first memory and backup
items.summary: Explain what is stored locally, provide a user-triggered export, and do not claim cloud backup or encryption that has not been implemented.

items.title: Truth and completion checks
items.summary: Separate proposed, in-progress, verified, and completed work; do not mark a task done just because a plan was generated.

items.title: Plain-language explanations
items.summary: Explain app states and technical terms in simple language alongside concise labels.

items.title: Safe public information pathways
items.summary: For earth imagery or science topics, point to reputable public information and mark research as unverified until checked.

items.title: Explicit human approval for consequential actions
items.summary: Keep payments, account access, messages, deletion, medical decisions, and other external or consequential actions behind explicit user review.

excludedFromAppContext: Personal identity and insurance claim documents
Payment card numbers, CVVs, balances, banking or payment credentials
API keys, passwords, and other secrets
Device-specific diagnostic identifiers and detailed memory logs
Unverified claims of external account access, financial activity, storage sync, or compliance certification
Instructions that could enable cyber abuse or hazardous biological work
